title: introduce-syncable-cred-presets-and-pausable-pullstream-facade
author: Asha Patel
description: Context: multiple teams requested a simpler, prescriptive set of credential profiles for common server and client flows plus a lightweight, pausable pullstream facade to simplify token priming and backpressure in long-lived streaming scenarios. Motivation: reduce app-level glue across Python/TS/Go SDKs, improve parity, and make retry/reauth interactions predictable when streams are paused/resumed. This PR implements a cross-SDK 'syncable' credential presets API (server, client, delegated) plus a pausable PullStream facade that unifies pause/resume semantics, heartbeats, and credential priming hooks. Changes are additive and opt-in; existing APIs are left intact. Compatibility notes: minor behavioral change when using the new pause() API (streams now buffer a single in-flight token batch by default); consumers that rely on exact timing should test with the new pause window. Linear items: ENG-3412 (credential presets), ENG-3599 (stream facade). Testing: comprehensive unit tests for each SDK, interop smoke tests (py<->ts loopback), and end-to-end Canary against the hosted runtime. Rollout: feature-flagged in SDKs, scheduled minor bumps for py/ts/go. Checklist: [x] design doc linked in Linear ENG-3412, [x] implement presets in py/ts/go, [x] pausable facade in all SDKs, [x] unit + integration tests, [x] docs snippets and examples, [x] release notes.
